title: Units of measure
terminalHelp: An end unit can start or end a conversion, but cannot connect other units. For example: box → piece is allowed; box → piece → bag is not.
listHint: Standard measures, custom units and units you already use. Alternative names appear with the same unit. Select a name to see its indirect relationships too.
undefinedContent: Content or piece count not defined yet

links.terminalHelp: Paths through an end unit are hidden. The end unit itself remains reachable as a starting or ending point.
links.title: Explore relationships
links.description: Choose a unit to see its direct and indirect conversions, together with the path connecting them.
links.placeholder: For example kg or wine bottle
links.choose: Enter a unit name or alias to get started.
links.unknown: ‘{{name}}’ is not known yet. First add a unit with a conversion.
links.undefined: This container has no defined content or piece count yet. Define a conversion using ‘Add unit’.
links.unconfigured: This name is already in use, but has no central conversion yet. Define one to connect it to other units.
links.none: This unit has no relationships to other units yet. Alternative names do refer to the same unit.

emptyDescription: Add a custom unit, such as a 75 cl bottle or a box of 6 pieces.
formDescription: Define the conversion once for the whole household. Give different sizes distinct names.

validation.name: Enter a name of up to 20 characters.
validation.referenceUnit: Enter a reference unit of up to 20 characters.
validation.aliases: Use up to 20 other names, each with up to 20 characters.

aliasesHelp: Other names for this same unit, separated by commas.
roundingHelp: For example 1 for whole bottles, or 0.001 to allow smaller purchase quantities.
deleteDescription: Remove this conversion from the central list. Recorded stock is preserved.
inUse: Cannot remove yet: {{names}} uses this unit as a reference. Change that reference first.
nameConflict: This name or alias already exists, or belongs to a fixed standard measure.
referenceInvalid: Choose a known reference. References cannot point to themselves or form a cycle.
noLongerExists: This unit was removed or renamed elsewhere. Close this dialog and check the latest list.
description: View all units and their relationships. Manage conversions for products and recipes.
examples: For example: 75 cl bottle = 75 cl, box of 6 = 6 pcs. Give different sizes distinct names. g, kg, ml, cl and l are already known. New conversions do not change stock quantities.
name: Unit name
loadFailed: Could not load units. Please try again.
saveFailed: Could not save units. Your changes are still here.
invalid: Check the units: names must be unique, amounts positive and references known. References cannot form a cycle. Standard measures such as kg cannot be redefined.
conflict: The units changed elsewhere. Load the latest list and review your change. Your draft is preserved.
